response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with deep full-stack, web, and systems background, but he has minimal C++ experience (a brief stint in 2014-2015 on C IDE components) and no evidence of the specific domain expertise required: industrial automation, IEC 62443, MQTT, message brokers, IoT protocols, or cloud platform architecture at the depth this role demands. His current skill set centers on TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web technologies rather than modern C++/STL development.
strengths: Extensive multi-domain software engineering experience (web, mobile, embedded, systems)
Strong track record of leadership, mentoring, and running technical workshops
Experience with high-performance, low-latency, async I/O systems (in DLang) showing relevant architectural thinking
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (single ~6-month role in 2014-2015)
No demonstrated experience with IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity standards
No evidence of MQTT, REST-based IoT development, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering seniority and architecture experience
